title: Copositive Characterizations of Convex Hull Pricing
summary: Due to the nonconvex binary constraints of unit commitment (UC), no uniform linear pricing scheme supports the optimal dispatch. Convex hull pricing (CHP) and copositive duality pricing (CDP) both address this problem. CHP derives the price from the subgradient of the value function of the convex hull relaxation of UC. CDP refers to several different pricing mechanisms that can be constructed from the dual multipliers of the completely positive programming reformulation.
